label: Modular spaceship from kit parts
description: Kit-bash a spacecraft from POLYGON_SciFi_Space SM_Veh_Part_* pieces: one body, one cockpit at the front (+Z), one to four engines at the rear (-Z), wings in mirrored pairs on +/-X, optional landing gear under the body (-Y), and greebles on the hull. All parts are authored at 1:1 - never scale. Complete SM_Ship_* prefabs are whole ships; use them as-is or as size references, not as parts.

steps.note: Origin of the ship. Everything else attaches relative to this body's bounds.
Seat at body bounds.max.z, centred on X, top flush with or slightly above body top.
At body bounds.min.z. 1 centred; 2 mirrored on +/-X; 4 in a 2x2 block.
Each pick is a pair: instance once at +X, once at -X mirrored (scale.x = -1 or the engine's mirror). Root at body bounds.max.x / min.x, mid-height.
Only for landed / hangar scenes. Under body bounds.min.y, one forward + two aft.
Hull detail on body/wing upper surfaces. Keep clear of cockpit glass.
Optional. Mount on hull top/bottom centreline or wing tips.
Complete ships for scale comparison / background traffic. Not parts.
